006package dev.metaschema.core.metapath.function;
007
008import java.util.ServiceLoader;
009import java.util.ServiceLoader.Provider;
010import java.util.stream.Stream;
011
012import dev.metaschema.core.metapath.StaticMetapathException;
013import dev.metaschema.core.qname.IEnhancedQName;
014import dev.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
015import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
016import nl.talsmasoftware.lazy4j.Lazy;
017
018/**
019 * Supports looking up named Metapath functions that are loaded using the
020 * {@link ServiceLoader} interface.
021 */
022public final class FunctionService implements IFunctionResolver {
023  private static final Lazy<FunctionService> INSTANCE = Lazy.of(FunctionService::new);
024  @NonNull
025  private final ServiceLoader<IFunctionLibrary> loader;
026  @NonNull
027  private final Lazy<IFunctionLibrary> library;
028
029  /**
030   * Get the singleton instance of the function service.
031   *
032   * @return the service instance
033   */
034  // FIXME: rename to instance()
035  @NonNull
036  public static FunctionService getInstance() {
037    return ObjectUtils.notNull(INSTANCE.get());
038  }
039
040  /**
041   * Construct a new function service.
042   */
043  @SuppressWarnings("null")
044  public FunctionService() {
045    this.loader = ServiceLoader.load(IFunctionLibrary.class);
046    ServiceLoader<IFunctionLibrary> loader = getLoader();
047
048    this.library = Lazy.of(() -> {
049      FunctionLibrary functionLibrary = new FunctionLibrary();
050      loader.stream()
051          .map(Provider<IFunctionLibrary>::get)
052          .flatMap(IFunctionLibrary::stream)
053          .forEachOrdered(function -> functionLibrary.registerFunction(ObjectUtils.notNull(function)));
054      return functionLibrary;
055    });
056  }
057
058  /**
059   * Get the function service loader instance.
060   *
061   * @return the service loader instance.
062   */
063  @NonNull
064  private ServiceLoader<IFunctionLibrary> getLoader() {
065    return loader;
066  }
067
068  @NonNull
069  private IFunctionLibrary getLibrary() {
070    return ObjectUtils.notNull(library.get());
071  }
072
073  /**
074   * Retrieve the collection of function signatures in this library as a stream.
075   *
076   * @return a stream of function signatures
077   */
078  @NonNull
079  public Stream<IFunction> stream() {
080    return getLibrary().stream();
081  }
082
083  @Override
084  public IFunction getFunction(@NonNull IEnhancedQName name, int arity) {
085    IFunction retval = getLibrary().getFunction(name, arity);
086
087    if (retval == null) {
088      throw new StaticMetapathException(StaticMetapathException.NO_FUNCTION_MATCH,
089          String.format("unable to find function with name '%s' having arity '%d'", name, arity));
090    }
091    return retval;
092  }
093}
